subject: Best practice for presenting the user a demo workflow; or how to update input elements successively?

messages.author: 1b286064599cfc15
messages.subject: Best practice for presenting the user a demo workflow; or how to update input elements successively?
parts:
Hi,

I would like to present the user a demo of the app workflow. 
What would be the best practice to do so? using update input function? bookmarking?

In my app, some of the input elements are built conditionally on the values of other input elements placed upstream in the workflow.
How can I use input updates, such that on button click, an input element gets a value, then wait for the successive input element to be rendered and update it as well and so forth...?

Thanks,
Shay.
